newsitem.title: UK: BRC UK October retail sales survey - table.
newsitem.headline: BRC UK October retail sales survey - table.

text.p: The British Retail Consortium published the following data on the annual percentage changes in the value of UK retail sales in October.

NOTE - The RETAIL SALES Monitor measures changes in actual value of RETAIL SALES from a sample of 75 retailers who account for around half total UK RETAIL SALES. Figures are re-weighted to remove any bias in the sample towards specific categories of spending. They are not otherwise adjusted for changes in seasonal influences or price changes.
The BRC says like-for-like figures will in general provide a more accurate guide to spending patterns, removing the effect of expansion in retail floor space on sales.
